description: This file defines a custom form field type 'TagsType' for use with Symfony's Form component, extending 'TextType' to add specific configuration for tags input with autocomplete features.

classes.name: TagsType
classes.description: A custom form type for handling tags input, with options for configuration such as URL for autocomplete and styling.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Configures default options for the form type, such as label attributes, row class, and URL for autocomplete.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Builds the form view, adding CSS classes and data attributes necessary for the tags input functionality.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the block prefix used for the custom form type in templates.
